title: Map tiles not downloaded when map area expanded

issues.title: Map tiles not downloaded when map area expanded
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Map tiles not downloaded when map area expanded

Note for @lebaphi : this may be the problem (and solution): https://stackoverflow.com/questions/53879753/leaflet-map-does-not-appear-correctly-until-resize

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1.Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Drag channel to make to multi sides
3. Click channel 'CoreMapping'
4. Drag chanel to expand map
4. Notice map tiles not downloaded to draw full map

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Enable to see full map in CoreMaping

## 🖥️ Screenshots


https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/aed1e8ac-a252-429a-99fd-a30bde6597bf


## 💻 System information
- Browser : Chrome
- Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111
